svg.title: Two doormen, one very selective door
svg.desc: Four-panel comic about VASP. Two doormen score every guest (an item) from 0 to 1: Routine, the linear model, knows the regulars; Vibes, the deep model, spots hidden patterns. The door lets in a combined score of 0.5 or more. A regular both like (0.9 and 0.8) gets in whether the scores are added (1.7) or multiplied (0.72). A guest who claims to be with the band gets 0.1 from Routine and 0.9 from Vibes: adding gives 1.0 and lets him in, a false positive; multiplying gives 0.09 and keeps him out. With only Routine at the door results get slightly worse; with only Vibes everyone with the band gets in and results get much worse. Adding works like OR, multiplying like AND: both models must agree.
svg.text: Two doormen, one very selective door

g.text: Routine is the one you can’t lose.

svg.text: Add = OR: one keen model can wave a wrong item in.
Multiply = AND (VASP): both models must agree.
